name: @microdelta/accounting
description: Resource Accounting: keyed usage observations, honest unknown usage and separate estimates

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && api-extractor run --config api-extractor.json && node ../../tooling/trim-declaration-imports.mjs dist/api/accounting.beta.d.ts dist/api/accounting.public.d.ts
scripts.check: concurrently --success all --names types,lint "npm run check:types" "npm run check:lint"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:types && npm run test:public
